activities: simulating a resistance band on a hip in opensim
dragging stars around her research constellation
connecting cards on a research canvas
vibe: A researcher, designer and maker who thinks through making, and builds quiet, moonlit interfaces that explain exactly why things connect.
lines: Yue means moon and Yang evokes the sun, so my site has a little half-lit circle as its mark.
My research constellation links 29 publications by shared features, not citations. Drag a star and the network reshapes!
Week 4 I used the human body as the environment: an OpenSim model doing a side leg raise against a band.
Honest result: 8 of 18 runs passed. Every failure missed the ON curve limit.
In one run the agent submitted a worse design than one it had already tested. Traces tell you so much.
I'm a visual thinker. Branchwork lets me see ideas, images and papers side by side on one canvas.
This week I'm with Group 6, building personalization for the Course Agent.
